name: Lincolnton
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lincolnton, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lincolnton, NC: the courthouse tree lighting with the Grinch movie, the 68th Christmas Parade and The Santa Switch musical.
lede: Lincolnton celebrates Christmas around its historic courthouse, with a tree lighting and movie night, a long running parade and a community theatre musical.
celebrates: Lincolnton lights its Christmas tree in front of the historic courthouse with hot chocolate, a kids' coloring booth, live music and Santa, then shows The Grinch on the courthouse lawn. Two days later the City of Lincolnton holds its 68th annual Christmas Parade, themed Christmas Through The Decades, from East Main Street through the Courtsquare to Lincolnton High School. The Lincoln Theatre Guild stages The Santa Switch, a holiday jukebox musical, at the Lincoln Cultural Center over three weekends.
lastyear: Lincolnton's parade is counted as the 68th this year, so the 2025 parade was the 67th. The City of Lincolnton says this year's theme invites floats from past, present or future decades. The tree lighting and Movie on the Square are listed by Lincoln County for November 27. We could not find a published 2025 recap, so the details come from the 2026 announcements.
facts: The Lincolnton parade starts at 4 pm on East Main Street at Flint Street, according to the city, and line up for entries begins at 2 pm. The route runs through the Courtsquare and up North Aspen Street to Lincolnton High School. The city lists parade awards that include Best Golf Cart and Best Youth Participation.
trains: Lincolnton has no train ride of its own on our list. The Bela Express train rides at the Kings Mountain Christmas Parade and Festival on December 5 are the closest holiday trains, and they are carried on our Gastonia page. Our Charlotte page lists THE POLAR EXPRESS in Spencer for families who want a longer trip.

faq: When is the Lincolnton Christmas Parade?
Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 4 pm. It starts on East Main Street at Flint Street and ends at Lincolnton High School.
When is the Lincolnton tree lighting?
Friday, November 27, 2026, at 6 pm in front of the historic courthouse, followed by The Grinch movie.
Is there a Christmas show in Lincolnton?
Yes. The Lincoln Theatre Guild presents The Santa Switch on November 27 and 28, December 4 and 5 at 7 pm and December 6 at 3 pm.
Yes. The city says the parade ends with a grand finale featuring Santa Claus.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Lincolnton for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Christmas Tree Lighting and Movie on the Square and the first night of The Santa Switch) through December 6, with the 68th Annual Lincolnton Christmas Parade (November 29) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Lincolnton

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Lincolnton
  • 1 free event: the 68th Annual Lincolnton Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: at the courthouse tree lighting and in the parade finale
  • Parades and shows: the parade on November 29 and The Santa Switch musical through December 6
  • Season: November 27, 2026 to December 6, 2026
